step.label: Assess Engineering Change Impact
step.description: Evaluate material and product changes to determine safety and operational implications before transition execution.
step.useCase: Manufacturing operations team needs to understand how product redesigns affect existing asset provisioning workflows and material sourcing.

step.label: Evaluate Operational Capability for Transition
step.description: Analyze production capacity, material availability, and resource readiness to support the proposed product and material changes.
step.useCase: Operations planners require cross-functional impact data on engineering changes before committing manufacturing resources.

step.label: Coordinate Safety Risk Assessment
step.description: Identify and classify safety hazards related to new materials or process changes triggered by the engineering transition.
step.useCase: Safety compliance officer must validate hazardous substance handling protocols and incident prevention measures for the new product configuration.

step.label: Collect Safety Performance Metrics
step.description: Aggregate baseline safety incident data and metrics to establish pre-transition safety baseline for comparison.
step.useCase: Risk management team requires historical safety incident data to establish benchmarks and monitor for regression post-transition.

step.label: Validate Vendor Service Readiness
step.description: Confirm that contracted vendors and external service providers can support the new IT equipment, change requests, and service tickets required for transition.
step.useCase: Procurement team needs to verify vendor SLAs and service capacity align with the transition timeline and equipment requirements.

step.label: Plan Sales Team Capacity and Availability
step.description: Coordinate sales workforce time off and capacity allocation to ensure coverage during product transition announcement and customer communication phase.
step.useCase: Sales leadership must schedule employee availability and manage time-off requests to maintain customer contact coverage during transition period.

step.label: Project Sales Opportunity Impact
step.description: Forecast revenue and opportunity pipeline changes resulting from the product transition using historical sales and customer data.
step.useCase: Finance and sales leadership need demand forecasts to model revenue impact and adjust quarterly targets based on product transition.

step.label: Monitor Production Quality During Transition
step.description: Establish quality inspection benchmarks and workforce performance targets to detect anomalies as manufacturing executes the product transition.
step.useCase: Manufacturing quality team requires real-time production order and inspection data to validate that transition execution meets quality standards.
